extracted_concepts.name: Vector in R^n
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An ordered n-tuple v = (v1, ..., vn).

extracted_concepts.name: Ordered n-tuple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The ordered list form of a vector in R^n.

extracted_concepts.name: Scalar multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: cv = (cv1, ..., cvn).

extracted_concepts.name: Linear combination
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: w = c1v1 + ... + ckvk.

extracted_concepts.name: Span
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The set of all linear combinations of vectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear independence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: c1v1 + ... + ckvk = 0 implies all coefficients are zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A linearly independent spanning set.

extracted_concepts.name: Dimension
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The number of vectors in any basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Finite-dimensional vector space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A vector space with a finite basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Change of basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relating coordinates of a vector under two bases.

extracted_concepts.name: Transition matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix P satisfying [x]_B' = P^{-1}[x]_B.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Coordinates of a vector relative to a basis, written [x]_B.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dimension of column space, also dimension of row space.

extracted_concepts.name: Nullity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dimension of null space.

extracted_concepts.name: Column space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Space spanned by columns of a matrix.

extracted_concepts.name: Row space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Space spanned by rows of a matrix.

extracted_concepts.name: Null space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solution space of Ax = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank-Nullity Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: rank(A) + nullity(A) = n.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Abstract framework for vectors and linear operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Systems understood through vector spaces.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Object representing linear equations and transformations.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mapping understood via vector spaces.

extracted_concepts.name: Zero vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector 0 used in the independence condition.

extracted_concepts.name: Basis Cardinality Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Any two bases for a finite-dimensional vector space have the same number of vectors.
